references.text: The Lord commands that all the firstborn among the children of Israel shall be consecrated to Him, both humans and animals.
Explains the law concerning the firstborn and links it to the Exodus from Egypt when the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt.
Describes the historical event when the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt at midnight.
Reiterates the command to give the Lord the firstborn of sons and of livestock.
A parallel passage explaining that all the firstborn belong to the Lord from the day He struck down the firstborn in Egypt.
The Lord commands Moses to count all the firstborn Israelite boys, and the Levites are taken in their place.
Confirms that the firstborn of animals already belongs to the Lord.
Refers to the law that every male firstborn shall be called holy to the Lord.
